caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.
Slovakia's 23% standard and 19% reduced rate reflect the January 2025 reform as listed by the Commission (table checked 2026-07-13).

From 1 January 2025 (Law 278/2024 Z. z., consolidation package) the standard rate rose from 20% to 23%, the 10% reduced rate was replaced by a new 19% rate and the 5% second reduced rate stayed (with a wider basket); the 5% rate itself was introduced on 1 January 2023 for state-supported rental housing (Law 222/2022 Z. z.). From 1 January 2026 selected items moved from 19% to 23% - a scope change. The superseded 20% and 10% rows are lower bounds.
